bootstrap.outputs: paired differences in mean daily MAE and WIS for all A1..A5 versus B0..B3; 95% percentile CIs, exploratory post-selection; missing calendar days have no loss and are excluded from replicate mean, never replace with zero loss
bootstrap.pairing: identical indices for every model in each replicate
bootstrap.peak: descriptive only, small effective sample; no independent-hour significance
bootstrap.within_fold: full chronological 90-calendar-day grid including 0-count excluded days; uniform noncircular consecutive block starts 0..N-7; concatenate ceil(N/7) blocks and truncate to N; keep each day hourly losses together

history.eligible: all inherited BASE_FEATURES nonnull and finite target; no extra evaluation exclusions

lear.alpha_units: multiply grid entry by max(population training target SD,1e-8); this is penalty-unit scaling only, target itself retains raw or row-normalized representation
lear.convergence: record warnings; nonconvergence is a failed fit, never silently accepted
lear.feature_construction: calendar-day/local-hour vectors; average both canonical observations in a repeated local hour; missing local hours remain NaN until training-only imputation; price D-3 is causal composition of inherited price history lag definitions
lear.final_fit: refit selected relative penalty on entire current window, recomputing imputer/scaler/target-SD on entire training only
lear.implementation: independent hourly L1-regularized linear regressions; cross-hour ARX structure, original implementation with sklearn Lasso, not copied epftoolbox source
lear.imputation: median per training feature; all-null column => 0, missing indicator for every feature; fit separately on inner training and final training
lear.inner_validation: last 28 calendar delivery days of current authorized training window, preceding rows train; no shuffle; all candidates same split per hour
lear.scaling: StandardScaler learned only on corresponding training partition after imputation
lear.select: lowest validation MAE in original EUR/MWh per local target hour; exact ties prefer grid order

lgbm.fits: one independent fresh daily fit per B3/A2, all eligible rows in authorized long window; no tuning

metrics.S_MAE: equal mean of five fold MAE(model)/MAE(B0)
metrics.daily_mean_level_MAE: mean over represented delivery days of abs(mean forecast - mean truth)
metrics.recovery: descriptive fold-3 windows 2022-09-01..07,08..14,15..21,22..28, plus daily MAE/coverage95; not selection
metrics.selection: rank A1..A5 by S_MAE then S_WIS then table order; best observed separately from first satisfying every plan section8 criterion
metrics.zero_reference: raise undefined comparison; require protocol correction before selection, never epsilon

normalization.level: arithmetic mean of exactly 168 canonical prices before local D midnight
normalization.other_predictors: unchanged before train-only LEAR imputation and scaling
normalization.scale: max(sample standard deviation ddof=1 of same 168,1 EUR/MWh)
normalization.training: each row uses its own historical-origin level and scale

origin.error_feedback: complete delivery days <=D-2 only; each issued pair consumed once
origin.legacy_source: src/delu_forecast/showcase.py gate_feasible_frame: 12:00 CET D-1; delivery calendar Europe/Berlin
origin.load: inherited A65 delivery-day forecasts; no A69 or target-day actuals; inherited source provenance, no new vintage availability claim
origin.price_boundary: all D-1 day-ahead prices, already published at the prior auction; no D prices
origin.timestamp: D-1 12:00 fixed UTC+01:00 (CET literally), hence 11:00 UTC; separate from Europe/Berlin delivery-hour/DST calendar

protocol_change_rule: no parameter or architecture changes informed by outer comparison; implementation defects corrected with explicit records and reruns, not hidden protocol tuning

quantiles.B1: exact preserved base final seven quantiles; original raw_p50 retained as central; no refit or error recalibration
quantiles.method: numpy.quantile(method=linear), pooled hourly errors in latest 28 complete released days
quantiles.output: central + empirical_error_quantile * current scale for normalized arms; scale multiplier 1 for raw; no clipping or final projection needed

resources.cache: data/cp15-cache (already ignored by data/*); decisions and per-origin lineage hashed; cached fit identity includes source/protocol/input hashes
resources.core: CPU, sequential origins; LGBM n_jobs=4; BLAS threads=1; no remote logging
resources.neural_probe: separate bounded local CPU/MPS process, no outer fold scoring; exact public revision/license verified before download; isolated pinned environment under ignored data/cp15-probe-env; hashes and dependency freeze committed

warmup.buffer: signed (actual-issued central) errors; raw for B0/B2/B3, divided by issued scale for A1/A2/A3/A4/A5; no retrospective refit residuals
warmup.eligible_complete_day: actual expected 23/24/25 canonical timestamps, finite prices, all inherited eligible rows, finite issued central forecast on every canonical hour
warmup.first_origin: find most recent 28 eligible complete days <= first evaluation D-2; begin genuine daily central forecasts on earliest of those days and continue every day through fold end
warmup.issuance: warm-up stores central forecasts only; no warm-up interval claims; evaluation begins only with 28 released complete forecast days
warmup.missing_day: incomplete days never enter buffer; eligible hours still evaluated; retain latest 28 complete days, potentially across calendar gaps
